title: Plan Monthly Savings publishes the open month extrapolated from one settled interval (x2688 to x2976)
claim: Through the production cycle, the first numeric state Plan Monthly Savings publishes in a new month is one settled 15-minute interval's saving multiplied by the coverage factor 2688 (Feb) / 2976 (Jan, install month), and the state swings by over 1700 in currency within the first hour (-1728.39, -1232.94, -1398.17, then 18.44).
mechanism: ledger.MonthlyLedger.savings_months scales every open-month figure by ledger.coverage_factor = month_hours / settled_hours with no floor on settled hours; MonthlySavingsSensor._waiting_for only asks for a row to exist, so the sensor publishes the estimate from the first booked interval. The sensor is enabled by default and is the card's savings headline (statEntity("_plan_monthly_savings")).

evidence.unit: coverage factor applied to the first numeric state of the new month (ratio); swing over the first four numeric states 1728.39 currency
evidence.contention_note: shared box with other finder seats running; deterministic (frozen clock, injected prices and inputs, no network)

perturbation.change: --min-hours 24: MonthlySavingsSensor._waiting_for also waits until the open month has 24 settled hours (in memory)

metric_definition: ledger.coverage_factor of the open month on the first cycle of the month whose MonthlySavingsSensor state is a number
phenomenon_property: A published open-month money estimate is not extrapolated from a settled span too short to bound it: the multiplier applied to the settled figures stays bounded (no estimate before a minimum settled coverage).
seam_rule: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D8/s1/monthly.py -v (every published reader of ledger.coverage_factor-scaled open-month figures: grep -n coverage_factor custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py)

null_control.note: the availability-only gate (finding D8-s1-03's fix) leaves the extrapolation unchanged; only the coverage floor moves it

reproduction_steps: run with --min-hours 24: no numeric state in the window, first_scale=0.0
proposed_fix_scope: a minimum settled coverage before the open month's estimate is published (sensor-side waiting_for or ledger-side), so the published multiplier is bounded
